item.tib: sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi yi 'byung khungs yid bzhin nor bu 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter mdzod
item.coloph: sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi yi byung khungs/ yid bzhin nor bu'i 'dod 'byung gter/ de nas rgyal sras pad rgyal gyis/ 'di ltar dgos zhes nan bskul ngor/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mthar/ rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son zhing / grub mtha' spyi yi dge ba'i bshes/ kun grol grags pa'i dpal 'bod pa'i/ rnga chen zhes pa me khyi lor/ 'dod 'phel zla ba'i dkar phyogs su/ shar rdza'i ljongs chen sa yi char/ a khod dar rgyas gling dgon du/ legs par rtsom (brtsams) pa'i yi ge pa/ shes rab blo ldan rin blo gros/ zung gis bgyis pa'i dge ba des/ bstan dang sems can don gang dag rgya che grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi yi 'byung khungs/ yid bzhin nor bu'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter mdzod ces bya ba'i gzhung de re zhig rdzogs so//
